chunks: If it is said: If the matter is as you have stated, it would be necessary that he does not know any of the miracles in this condition, and this leads to not knowing prophethood and the veracity of the Messenger, which further takes him out of Islam, let alone faith.
ai.seo_question: What is the theological argument regarding the Imam's knowledge of miracles during occultation?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi uses this passage to refute the objection that the Imam's knowledge is restricted during the Minor Occultation (al-Ghaybah al-Sughra). He argues that if the Imam lacked awareness of prophetic miracles, his status as the authentic successor would be invalidated, thereby undermining the very foundation of Islamic faith and the validity of the Imamate.
